about: Controls the desktop Controlnet mode offers (#635). Each entry needs owner-observed DT+ results for every listed input type. 'family' is the catalogue base_model of the checkpoints it admits; 'models' narrows it to exact checkpoints when only those were observed. The DT+ inventory decides which entries are available. A control also needs its request encoding in core/pose.py and the Draw Things wire module; entries without one are refused at load.

controls.label: Union Pro 2.0 q5p
controls.evidence: Owner runs on DT+ (#633): Pose with FLUX.1 Dev q5p and Schnell q4p at weight 0.9, Balanced, 0 to 0.65, also with HiRes on Dev; Canny and Depth with Schnell q4p and PixelWave Schnell. Segmentation did not follow, so it is not offered.

controls.label: Union Pro 2.0 q8p
controls.evidence: Not verified: the owner runs used Union Pro 2.0 q5p.

controls.label: Xinsir Union ProMax (SDXL Turbo)
